description_ru: Бен находит под деревом мокрого щенка и просит родителей оставить его, но у собаки оказывается хозяин.
text:
Ben: Mum! Mum! Come to the garden, quick!
Mum: What is it? I am on the phone.
Ben: There is a dog under the tree. A little brown dog. He is wet and he is very sad.
Mum: A dog? Ben, don't touch him. We don't know him.
Ben: But he looks at me. Look at his eyes. He wants a friend.
Mum: Okay, I come. Oh. He is very small, and so thin. Hello, little one. Don't be afraid.

Ben: He is not afraid. He likes you. Mum, can we keep him?
Mum: Keep him? No, no. He has a family. Maybe somebody looks for him now.
Ben: He has no collar.
Mum: That is true. But we cannot decide this in the rain. First, we give him some water. Go and get a bowl.
Ben: I run! Don't go away, dog!

Ben: Here is the water. And I bring a piece of chicken from the fridge.
Mum: Ben! That is for dinner.
Ben: He is hungry, Mum. Look, he eats it very fast.
Mum: Yes, I see. Poor little dog. Okay, we dry him with a towel. Then we ask the neighbours.
Ben: And if nobody wants him?
Mum: Then we call the animal centre. They know what to do.
Ben: The animal centre? But he does not like a big strange place. He likes the garden.
Mum: Ben, please. One step at a time.

Dad: Hello, everybody. Why are you in the rain? And who is this?
Ben: Dad! This is Biscuit.
Dad: Biscuit? Is that his name?
Ben: Yes, I think so. He is the colour of a biscuit.
Dad: I see. And is Biscuit staying for dinner?
Mum: Please don't ask. Your son wants to keep him.
Dad: Ah. I understand. Ben, come here. Sit with me. Dogs are a big job. You must walk them every day, in the rain and in the snow.
Ben: I know. I walk him every morning before school. I promise.
Dad: And you must clean his bowl and play with him, not only for one week, but for many years.
Ben: For many years. I promise, Dad. Really.

Mum: We cannot say yes today. First, we ask the neighbours. Maybe tomorrow we know more.
Ben: Can Biscuit sleep in the kitchen tonight? It is cold outside.
Dad: Hmm. Just one night. In the kitchen, on the old blanket.
Ben: Thank you, thank you! You are the best parents in the world!
Mum: Don't thank us yet.

Ben: Mum, I cannot sleep. I hear a noise in the kitchen.
Mum: It is only the dog, Ben. Go back to bed.
Ben: He cries. I think he is lonely.
Mum: Okay, okay. Take your pillow. You can sleep next to him on the floor.
Ben: Really? Oh, thank you, Mum.
Mum: Don't tell your father.

Dad: Good morning. Why are there two sleeping people on my kitchen floor?
Mum: Shh. They are very tired. I think the dog snores.
Dad: And the boy snores too. Nice.
Ben: Mmm. I am not sleeping. Is it morning? Did anybody call?
Mum: Yes. Last night I sent a message to all the neighbours, and this morning Mrs. Evans from number twelve called. She says a dog of this colour lives in the old house at the end of the road. The old man there is in hospital. His dog is alone.
Ben: Oh. So Biscuit has a family. Is the man okay?
Mum: He is fine, but he stays in hospital for one more week. And then he needs help with the dog, because he is old.
Ben: What does that mean?

Dad: It means we can walk the dog while he is in hospital. And maybe visit them when he is home again.
Ben: So Biscuit is not ours?
Dad: He is a friend. A friend with a big heart. Is that okay?
Ben: Yes. I think it is a good idea. I am a little sad, but I am a little happy too.
Mum: That is a very grown-up thing to say, Ben.
Ben: Can we visit the old man today? I want to tell him that his dog is safe.
Dad: I think he likes that. Get dressed, and we go after breakfast.
Ben: And I bring a card for the old man. I draw a picture of Biscuit, with a big smile.
Mum: What a lovely idea. Draw one for yourself too.
Ben: Why?
Mum: Because Biscuit stays in our garden every afternoon next week, and your picture can wait for him on your wall.
Ben: Mum! You say yes to the dog!
Mum: I say yes to a visit. Only a visit.
Ben: A very long visit. Ha ha!
Dad: Ben, eat your breakfast first. And this time, nobody gives the chicken to the dog.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Рот открыт шире, чем для «э»; звук между «э» и «а».
Кончик языка не касается нёба и не вибрирует; не раскатывайте русское «р».
Начните с «э» и плавно перейдите в «и»; это один слитный звук.
Начните с «э» и плавно перейдите в «у»; британский вариант слитный.

questions.question: Where does Ben find the dog?
questions.answer: Under the tree in the garden.

questions.question: What name does Ben give the dog?
Where does Ben sleep that night?
questions.answer: On the kitchen floor next to the dog.

questions.question: Who really owns the dog?
questions.answer: An old man from the end of the road, who is in hospital.
